description: This file defines the StreamFactory class implementing the StreamFactoryInterface, responsible for creating stream objects from strings, files, or resources within the Laminas Diactoros HTTP message library.

classes.name: StreamFactory
classes.description: Implements methods for creating stream objects from various sources such as strings, files, or resources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream from a given string content, returning a StreamInterface object.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from a specified file with a given mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from an existing resource.
